item.description:
Typing that keeps up

  • Typing a reply or a new email is much faster: each letter no longer redraws the whole email and conversation around it.
  • The To and Subject fields respond at once, even in a large mailbox.
  • Contact suggestions in To appear instantly, and opening a new email no longer pauses to gather your contacts.
  • iPhone: contact suggestions in To are faster and no longer stall when new mail arrives.

Inbox zero, faster and quieter

  • Work through your inbox from the keyboard: J and K move between emails, E archives and opens the next, Shift-E moves back to the Inbox, H snoozes, S flags, U marks read or unread, C composes. Press ? to see every shortcut.
  • Choose several emails with X, Shift-arrows or ⌘A and archive, snooze, flag or trash them together. Z undoes your last change exactly.
  • Snooze offers Later today, This evening, Tomorrow morning, This weekend and Next week. Cove reminds you when an email is back in your inbox (sender and subject only).
  • One click archives everything in Other.
  • Cove opens faster: a large mailbox loads about seven times quicker, and opening an HTML email takes a third of the time.
  • Archiving, marking read or labeling while offline keeps your change and sends it to Gmail when you’re back. Background sync never interrupts you; if Google signs you out, Cove shows one “Sign in to Google again” button.
  • Quitting Cove saves what you were typing and finishes a pending send first.
  • iPhone: snooze with a swipe, a Snoozed folder, offline changes that keep, and a quieter sync.

Faster writing, and everyone in To

  • Typing a new email or a reply, moving between emails and opening a conversation are faster: Cove no longer re-scans the whole mailbox as you go.
  • The To field suggests anyone you’ve emailed, not only recent mail. After a short pause, Cove looks up matching names and addresses in Gmail; it never reads the emails’ text for this.
  • Loading older mail, label views, search results and images inside emails is faster.
